observations.behavior: Adds a new kea module pushDeviceCheckLogic.ts in products/workflows/frontend/setupGuide/wizard. It connects to integrationsLogic, filters for apns/firebase, and uses HogQL to count persons with a device push subscription property or recent $set events. It implements a polling strategy with backoff and cache, and captures a posthog event on detection.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks device registration status for push notifications and records a workflow onboarding event. This could help PostHog track setup completion and potentially correlate push setup with other workflow stages.
